SECTION: Chapter 5 | Article 3. Institutional Student Programs and Services. These are programs and activities the University offers to facilitate the delivery of essential services to the students. It refers to the services and programs designed to proactively provide for the basic health, food, shelter, and safety concerns of students including students with special needs and disabilities.
Article 3. Institutional Student Programs and Services. These are programs and activities the University offers to facilitate the delivery of essential services to the students. It refers to the services and programs designed to proactively provide for the basic health, food, shelter, and safety concerns of students including students with special needs and disabilities.

Sec. 1. Admission and Testing Services

1.1. Recruit prospective college students through career information.

1.2. Administer college entrance test and conduct intake interview for all incoming university students and transferees as a process for admission.

1.3. Prepare and update testing materials.

1.4. Keep files and records systematically.

1.5. Interpret and evaluate college entrance test results and post them on the bulletin board.

1.6. Strictly follow the admission policies of the university.

1.7. Assist incoming college students, facilitate admission requirements and similar documents.

1.8. Recommend alternatives/options, if necessary, for students who failed the admission requirements.

1.9. Administer psychological tests for students who have special cases.

Sec. 2.

SECTION: Chapter 4 | Article 3. GSAR Admission Requirements, Policies, and Registration
Article 3. GSAR Admission Requirements, Policies, and Registration

Sec. 1. GSAR Admission Requirements and Registration. Registration, completed by semester and midyear annually, is an essential process that certifies LSPU has all necessary information about the students. Some details will be taken like the personal, program of study, and confirmation of status as a continuing student for the forthcoming academic year.

1.1. New Graduates

1.1.1. original Transcript of Records (TOR)

1.1.2. Permit to Study form/letter (if employed)

1.1.3. four (4) copies of photographs, 2x2” in size

1.1.4. Application Form for Admission and Examination

1.1.5. photocopy of Marriage Certificate (if original TOR was acquired when not yet married, female only)

1.1.6. average rating of 85% or 2.0 in the entire undergraduate course. An applicant with lower grades shall be conditionally admitted and become a regular student only upon earning grades not lower than 2.0 in nine (9) units of foundation subjects and nine (9) units in major subjects.

1.1.7. entrance examination and interview results with a passing rate

Sec. 4. Expenses. The mandatory drug testing will be a part of the University admission and retention policy starting this First Semester A.Y. 2018-2019. Payment of testing fee shall be shouldered by the students and shall be paid directly by the students to the drug testing service provider accredited by

DOH.

Sec. 5. LSPU – MDTP Procedure. All students will undergo drug testing as part of the University Policy for admission and retention program and will be a part of annual physical examination. For its first year of implementation starting this First Semester A.Y. 2018-2019.

The following procedure:

5.1. Notification

5.1.1. All incoming freshmen and old students shall be secured by a “drug testing consent form” before the testing
